items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: I've just been crazy to try to get somebody, a Harry Shields and Raymond Blake and all of them. Played with him to try to give me the lowdown on him

ctx.x: Yes. Of Emmett Hardy's. They've hunted and hunted for that. And it's supposed to have been done on an old Addison dictaphone machine.

Of course, I was in New York. I had to be in New York when Emmett Hardy was playing. And ever since I've heard about Emmett Hardy, I've just been crazy to try to get somebody, a Harry Shields and Raymond Blake and all of them.
Played with him to try to give me the lowdown on him at Hardy's playing. And to this day, I have never gotten a tale that would match up with the other one. So I still don't
